subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new public `MemoryRerankProvider` plugin SDK seam plus `memoryRerankProviders` manifest contract for builtin memory search?
rationale: This is an additive feature but it expands the public plugin contract, picks an exclusive-slot model, and defines qmd as out of scope; those API choices become compatibility commitments after release.

options.title: Accept After Refresh
options.body: Approve the dedicated opt-in SDK seam and require a rebase that preserves current-main abort-signal behavior before merge.

options.title: Request API Revisions
options.body: Ask the author to change the provider slot model, manifest gate, candidate shape, qmd scope, or docs before this becomes public API.

options.title: Pause Behind RFC
options.body: Keep the PR open but unmerged until maintainers settle the broader memory rerank direction in #89477.

recommendation.title: Accept After Refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the dedicated opt-in SDK seam and require a rebase that preserves current-main abort-signal behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant history is on memory host SDK and plugin SDK boundary work, which is the public contract being expanded here.
